name: ruby-hash-chain-cli
title: Ruby Hash Chain CLI
blurb: Append-only hash chain in Ruby: each entry commits to the previous digest, so tampered, dropped or reordered history fails verification; stdlib only
default_description: A Ruby tamper-evident hash chain CLI.

verify.name: verify
verify.cmd: bin/{{ npm_name }} append '{"event":"paid"}' --file chain-smoke.ndjson --at 200 >/dev/null && bin/{{ npm_name }} verify --file chain-smoke.ndjson | grep -qx 'ok 2 entries'

verify.name: tamper
verify.cmd: sed -i 's/created/edited/' chain-smoke.ndjson; bin/{{ npm_name }} verify --file chain-smoke.ndjson >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 1; rm -f chain-smoke.ndjson

verify.name: bad-payload
verify.cmd: bin/{{ npm_name }} append 'not json' --file x.ndjson >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 1; rm -f x.ndjson
